name: Yong Benitez
headline: Executive Virtual Assistant, Podcast Manager, and Digital Marketing Support
bioSummary: 4+ years of experience fueling the growth of business owners, executive teams, and creative visionaries. I specialize in the intersection of General and Executive Support, Podcast Management, and Digital Marketing - the three pillars that turn a chaotic to-do list into a streamlined engine for success.

I do not just manage tasks; I build the infrastructure that allows you to scale. My approach is rooted in creating organizational harmony, ensuring that while you focus on the big picture, the day-to-day operations run with surgical precision.
mission: I help you reduce the noise and eliminate the overwhelm, so you can lead an efficient, stress-free, and high-impact business.
